entities.name: Great Glacier
entities.description: One of the great glaciers covering parts of Terisiare during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent on Dominaria covered by glaciers.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Mage who raised a Glacial Wall at the glacier's edge to protect the School of the Unseen.

entities.name: School of the Unseen
entities.description: Magical school protected by the glacier.

entities.name: Glacial Wall
entities.description: Magical wall Jodah erected at the glacier's edge.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Period of extreme cold on Dominaria.

entities.name: Thaw
entities.description: Period when glaciers began to melt.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Flooding after which the glacier retreated fully.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: Island connected to the mainland when the glacier locked up the sea.

events.summary: The Great Glacier grew over Lat-Nam straits and buried places such as Eln Forest and Shingol.
events.quote: The glacier grew over the Lat-Nam straits and the western shore of the continent

events.summary: Jodah used the glacier to protect the School of the Unseen with a Glacial Wall.
events.quote: Jodah utilized the presence of the glacier to the benefit of the School of the Unseen

events.summary: During the Flooding of Terisiare the Great Glacier retreated fully.

relations.quote: Jodah utilized the presence of the glacier to the benefit of the School of the Unseen
